cases.description: Should trigger: DSAR handling across systems with identity verification and redaction
cases.input: A customer emailed requesting all personal data we hold on them (Art. 15) and deletion (Art. 17). We have data in our main DB, Zendesk, and Mailchimp.
cases.expect: Walks the DSAR workflow: verify identity, acknowledge within the regulatory timeline, scope the request, retrieve data across all systems, redact third-party data, deliver securely, and document
assertions: Verifies identity without excessive data collection
Acknowledges within the regulatory timeline (GDPR: max 1 month)
Searches production, backups, logs, and analytics for the data
Redacts or anonymizes other individuals' data before responding

cases.description: Should trigger: breach response with jurisdiction-specific notification timelines
cases.input: Our customer database was accessed by an unauthorized party. Customers are in the EU, California, and Brazil. The breach happened 30 hours ago.
cases.expect: Runs the breach response workflow: contain, assess scope, then notify regulators and individuals per jurisdiction timeline (GDPR 72h, CCPA promptly, LGPD 72h)
assertions: Starts with containment, then assesses data scope
Cites GDPR 72-hour supervisory authority notification
Handles multiple jurisdictions (EU, CCPA, LGPD) with their timelines
Documents actions, timelines, and decisions for accountability

cases.description: Should trigger: GDPR applicability determination and baseline requirements
cases.input: We're a US startup selling to EU customers — we collect emails, names, and payment info, and use behavioral analytics. Does GDPR apply?
cases.expect: Applies the GDPR applicability questions (EU/EEA establishment, offering goods/services, monitoring behavior) and walks the Article 30 ROPA fields
assertions: Determines GDPR applies via the four applicability questions
Walks data mapping / ROPA fields (purpose, categories, legal basis, transfers)
Checks for lawful basis before collection
Flags cross-border transfer concerns

cases.description: Should trigger: CCPA/CPRA obligations including opt-out and sale/sharing
cases.input: E-commerce site with California customers; we share purchase history with ad partners and don't have a Do Not Sell link.
cases.expect: Produces a CCPA assessment: determine applicability thresholds, add Do Not Sell/Share mechanism, update privacy notice, and cover the consumer rights table
assertions: Checks CCPA applicability criteria (revenue, records, revenue share)
Requires an opt-out mechanism (Do Not Sell/Share link)
Covers Right to Know / Delete / Opt-Out timelines
Audits data sharing with third parties

cases.description: Should trigger: HIPAA applicability and safeguards for health data processing
cases.input: Health app syncing heart rate and sleep data from wearables to a cloud backend, with optional sharing to the user's doctor. Does HIPAA apply?
cases.expect: Determines covered-entity/business-associate status and walks HIPAA Privacy/Security/Breach rules, including BAA requirements and safeguard categories
assertions: Walks the covered entity / business associate determination
Covers PHI identifiers and minimum necessary standard
Lists administrative, physical, and technical safeguards
Addresses breach notification rule timelines

cases.description: Not trigger: non-privacy software engineering task
cases.input: Refactor the authentication module to use an in-memory cache and add unit tests.
cases.expect: Does not enter the privacy compliance workflow; treats as a plain engineering task
assertions: No DSAR/breach/consent workflow invoked
Handled as ordinary code work
